title: Taro Cubes in Coconut Milk
description: Taro Cubes in Coconut Milk Recipe by Kasma Loha-unchit.

author: Kasma Loha-unchit
ingredients: 2 cups or 1 14-oz. can unsweetened coconut milk
body:
Be sure to read Kasma's article Taro (Bpeuak) – Smooth & Creamy.

Ingredients

  • 2 to 3 cups of 1/2-inch taro cubes
  • 2 cups or 1 14-oz. can unsweetened coconut milk
  • 1/4 - 1/2 cup granulated sugar
  • 1/4 - 1/2 tsp. sea salt

In a saucepan, heat coconut milk with sugar and salt until well blended. Bring to a boil, add the taro pieces and cook over low to medium heat until tender (about 7-10 minutes). Serve warm for best flavor.

Do you like taro? Try Kasma's recipe Stewed Taro with Green Onions.
